name: Pedal (current canon)
summary: Today's Pedal system, rendered from canon so every option is judged against it.
traits: Google Sans at 400/500/700, one typeface for display and body
Teal #5DA490 accent with night #1A1A2E text, borders and dark sections
Signature 2px night border and hard offset shadow on cards
Tight radii (6px controls, 10px cards) on a 4px spacing base
Status --warning #F8AB41 is used as text on --warning-surface; it reads low-contrast in the sample

name: Atlassian Design System
summary: Atlassian's system for Jira and Confluence; calm, collaborative product UI.
traits: Atlassian Sans first in the stack (not openly hosted, so the sample falls back to the system font); 653-weight headings, 14px body
Blue #1868DB brand fill and links on white, with a #F8F8F8 sunken ground
1px translucent borders and a two-layer raised shadow on cards
Radii of 6px on controls, 8px on cards and 12px on large panels

name: Carbon (IBM)
summary: IBM's enterprise system; square, flat and grid-strict, built for data-heavy work.
traits: IBM Plex Sans and Plex Mono; headings at regular (400) weight with 14px body
Blue #0F62FE primary and links on white, with #F4F4F4 grey layers
Square corners, no card shadows, 1px #C6C6C6 subtle borders
Status --support-warning #F1C21B is used as text on its notification background; it reads low-contrast in the sample

name: Material 3 (Google)
summary: Google's system; tonal colour roles generated from one seed, soft and rounded.
traits: Roboto throughout, headlines at regular (400) weight
Purple primary #65558F with lavender tonal containers on a tinted near-white surface
No card borders by default; level-1 elevation is a two-layer soft shadow
Radii of 8px (small), 12px (medium) and 16px (large)

name: Polaris (Shopify)
summary: Shopify's admin system; compact merchant UI with a near-black brand fill.
traits: Inter, with a 13px base size and slightly tightened heading tracking
Near-black #303030 primary fill and blue links on a light grey ground
1px light borders plus soft bevel shadows on cards
Radii of 8px on controls and 12px on cards and panels

name: Primer (GitHub)
summary: GitHub's system; dense, neutral product UI built for code and data.
traits: System font stack, no brand typeface
Green primary button, blue links and accents on near-white grounds
1px grey borders and very soft shadows
Radii of 6px (small/medium) and 12px (large)

name: Radix Themes
summary: Radix's themeable component system; accessible 12-step colour scales and neutral defaults.
traits: System font stack (no brand typeface), bold headings with no added tracking
Indigo accent on a white ground with 12-step gray and status scales
1px translucent gray borders; the default surface card has no shadow
Radii of 6px on controls and 8px on cards at the medium radius setting
source: @radix-ui/themes 3.3.0 (npm), light, indigo accent, gray, medium radius, 100% scaling

name: Ledger (generated · calm editorial)
summary: Quiet, print-like system; a serif display over a clean sans for reports and long reads.
traits: Newsreader serif headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono code
Forest green #24433A primary on warm paper #F7F5F0
1px warm-grey hairlines, near-flat shadow
Small radii (4px controls, 6px cards, 10px panels)
source: Shallan, 2026-11-16; original direction, all text pairs checked at WCAG AA

name: Orchard (generated · warm playful)
summary: Friendly, rounded system with a warm tangerine accent and soft lifted cards.
traits: Bricolage Grotesque headings, DM Sans body, JetBrains Mono code
Tangerine #C8441C primary on cream #FFF8F1
1px peach borders with a soft warm drop shadow
Generous radii (10px controls, 16px cards, 24px panels)
Primary tangerine and danger red sit close in hue: Save and Pause read alike
source: Shallan, 2026-11-16; original direction, all text pairs checked at WCAG AA

name: Signal (generated · bold graphic)
summary: High-contrast, sharp-cornered system with one electric colour doing all the work.
traits: Space Grotesk headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono code
Electric indigo #3D2BFF primary on pure white and black
1px black rules, no shadows
Square corners everywhere (0px radius)
source: Shallan, 2026-11-16; original direction, all text pairs checked at WCAG AA
